verdict.rationale: Outbound event webhooks are a fair question for a knowledge-base app with an API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only inbound mechanisms: a local HTTP API server for POST /api method calls, the logseq:// x-callback-url protocol, and a plugin API. Plugins are developer building blocks rather than a registrable outbound HTTP callback feature, and nothing in the pack shows registering webhooks or subscribing to events.
